title: MZ Is there any way to remove the "button look" of RPG Maker MZ?

posts.author: Elmorethemagician
posts.body:
I'm loving this engine so far... but I wanted to make a pixel art game with it, is there any way to remove these borders around the buttons/choice selection?
I tried disabling the touch UI options but that didn't seem to help.(?)
I tried searching for plugins but I couldn't really find anything, I'm completely new to this engine but I've tried the previous version (RPG Maker MV) so this is a little bit staggering for me. I honestly don't mind the transparent highlighter, I'm just trying to get rid of the "button look" if that's possible.
